mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate suggests a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals increased economic activity, which can lead to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 70% of the instances when INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which can lead to a slowdown in the economy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST decreases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls suggests strong job growth, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and increasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are above the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal savings (RSAFS) indicates reduced consumer savings, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS decreases significantly.
